profile.Name: Bugmaster
profile.Personality: A maniacal criminal who attacks on sight. How he commands his spiders, and why, is unknown.
profile.Backstory: He lives in the Throne of the Bugmaster in the crater of Arach, guarded by a huge army of Skin and Blood Spiders. He is wanted for banditry, raiding, mass murder, cannibalism, and genocide, and is said to hoard treasure.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his is recorded.
